contract.title: R03 result and route cold review
contract.goal: Audit whether PRESSURE_CANDIDATE is supported without overclaiming, using the persisted analysis and frozen decision contract. Check the three candidate links, same-episode queue evidence, physical/drain controls, identical packet fates, and the execution-incident boundary. Then challenge the proposal to confirm the same 5/2 MHz bracket with trace seeds 11 and 19 (three seeds total including 7) before using the scenario for Q0/information experiments. Return PASS_WITH_LIMITS or REQUEST_CHANGES, with blockers separated from nonblocking limits. Do not edit files, do not propose 1 MHz, RL training, or a larger matrix.
acceptance: Cite exact repository paths and concrete persisted fields for every major finding.
Recompute or cross-check the pressure classification inputs rather than trusting RESULT-REVIEW prose.
Separate single-seed engineering evidence from any paper-facing claim.
Assess whether two additional fixed trace seeds are sufficient for the next bounded gate and state open items.
